environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 service deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), exposed directly via public ALB with no access restrictions. Security groups allow 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080. Container runs as root with /tmp mounted as a standard ext4 filesystem. No network-level IP filtering. The /shutdown endpoint is reachable by any client that can guess the admin token.

config.network: ALB with default listener rules, no IP restrictions
